title: Sephiri sa Setulo sa Bogosi se se Kgakala
intro: Kgosi e e maatla, e e segofaditsweng ka puso e e sa tlwaelegang, e ne ya lebana le kgwetlho e e sa tlwaelegang e e neng e ama kgosigadi e e tswang kwa nageng e e kgakala. Kgosi e ne ya batla go bontsha maatla le botlhale jwa bomodimo, ya simolola tiragalo e e gakgamatsang e e neng e sa dumalane le melao ya nako le ya lefelo. A o ka kgona go swetsa ka dintlha tsa tiragalo eno e e gakgamatsang?
clues: Mmusi o ne a newa maatla a magolo thata, go akaretsa le go laola ditshedi tse di sa bonweng le bokgoni jwa go laola diphefo.
Mmusi yono o ne a amogela dikgang tsa kgosigadi e e humileng e e neng e obamela letsatsi, mme a swetsa go mo laletsa kwa kgotleng.
Pele ga kgosigadi e goroga, mmusi o ne a bontsha gore o eletsa go tlisa setulo sa gagwe se sentle sa puso go tswa kwa bogosing jwa gagwe jo bo kgakala.
Jinn e e nonofileng e ne ya ithaopela go tsaya selo seo pele ga mmusi a ka tsoga mo lekgotleng la gagwe.
Lefa go ntse jalo, mongwe yo o nang le kitso e e tseneletseng ya Dikwalo Tsa Bomodimo o ne a ntsha tsela ya go bona dilo ka bonako le go feta, a wetsa tiro eo ka go panya ga leitlho.
Fa e goroga, mmusi o ne a laela gore selo seo se fetolwe go leka tlhaloganyo le temogo ya kgosigadi fa kgabagare a goroga kwa ntlong ya segosi.

outcome.label: Botso
options: Go Ikoba ga Kgosigadi mo go Allah
outcome.answer: Go Ikoba ga Kgosigadi mo go Allah

verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
